purpose: Countdown 倒计时; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCountdown](../../lib/src/components/countdown.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Derive remaining time from deadline, never accumulate timer drift; finish once per deadline, cancel on disposal.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints. NumberSurface owns only the shared outer decoration; NumberPlate owns the inner numeric plate. The component owns its time model, callbacks, semantics and opaque slots; explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Reduced motion settles digit timeline and endpoints. Re-enabling motion cannot resume a prior transition. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: The existing dashed recipe in each supported size, applicable state and target pixel ratio, with opaque content
scenarios.when: Render and update the same component, including its current hover/press/focus and stroke-width recipes where applicable
scenarios.then: The contour, final short dash and inset match the unchanged recipe; all drawing uses the shared public foundation mechanism. Content geometry, callback/focus behavior and lifecycle remain unchanged under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke.
